base.title: Make PDF look scanned
base.description: Make a clean digital file look like a real scan — paper texture, noise, rotation and shadows, processed locally in your browser.

serviceWorker.needRefresh: New version available, click to refresh.

landing.headline: Make PDF look scanned
landing.subhead: Turn PDFs, images, Word and Excel files into realistic scanned copies with blur, noise, rotation, watermarks and stamps — right in your browser. Source files stay on your device.
landing.note: Free · No signup · Files stay on your device

points.local: Local processing · Source files stay put
points.preview: Real-time preview · What you see is what you export

landing.stepsTitle: Three steps to a scanned PDF
landing.step1Body: Drop in a PDF, an image, or a Word or Excel document. The file stays in your browser.
landing.step2Body: Blur, noise, rotation, paper tone, watermarks and stamps — with a live preview.
landing.step3Body: Your scanned PDF is generated in seconds and downloads straight away.
landing.footer: Turn documents into scans in your browser. Nothing is uploaded for processing.

seo.homeTitle: Make PDF Look Scanned Online — Free, Private, No Upload
seo.homeDescription: Make PDF look scanned: add grain, blur, a slight tilt and an aged paper tone. Free, no signup — your file never leaves the browser. Works with images and Word.

privacy.title: Private, local processing
privacy.description: Your files are processed in this browser. They are not uploaded to a processing server and are not stored in the cloud.

speed.title: Fast conversion
speed.description: Turn PDFs, images and Office documents into scanned-looking PDFs in seconds — no printer and no scanner.

customization.title: Scan effects
customization.description: Fine-tune blur, noise, rotation, brightness, contrast and paper tone with a live preview. What you see is what you export.

openSource.title: Chrome extension
openSource.description: The same scan engine is also available as a free Chrome extension, so you can process PDFs from the side panel.

mobileFriendly.title: Works on phones
mobileFriendly.description: The converter runs in modern mobile browsers. No installation is required for the website.

offlineUse.title: Works offline
offlineUse.description: Once the app resources are cached, standard scanning keeps working without a network connection.
